name: Employee Child Abuse Perpetrator Listing Report
description: Written report that the employee has been listed as a perpetrator in the Statewide database under the Child Protective Services Law.
quote: Employees shall also report to the Superintendent or designee, in writing, within seventy-two (72) hours of notification, that the employee has been listed as a perpetrator in the Statewide database, in accordance with the Child Protective Services Law.
